coverage.finding: The top-left ink folio number reads '218' with a superscript 'b' followed by a dot. The candidate record matches the image.

The ink line 'ff. 6 and 28-96, inc., much damaged.' (about y≈1840) is legible and matches the candidate. The dot below the space between 'much' and 'damaged' is present. The note's height matches c. 308 (3) on fol. 219, but its parent entry remains unestablished.

Faint pencil 'ā/ nd/' with dots below 'nd'. The slash after 'nd' is a long descending stroke (about y 1860-2070). The 'nd/' is also visible at the left edge of the fol. 219 image, which confirms this is target-page material. The reading remains uncertain.

The ink line (about y≈2330) matches the candidate. The final digit of '103' looks written over another digit. There appears to be a stroke above the 'a' of 'Bhag', so a macron ('Bhāg.') is possible; this has been added as an uncertainty. The note's height agrees with c. 102 (1) on fol. 219.

The ink note '? Enter Rajñistava here as Rajñistava' (about y≈3700) is represented. A tilde stands over the n in both words. A horizontal top stroke on the second R may be either a flourish or a macron, so this is unresolved. A '→' in the facing page's margin stands at roughly the same height; the relationship evidence has been updated to record this.
Faint pencil 'm/' (about x≈2924, y≈3976), with a dot below the 'm' and a long slash. It is level with the 'collection of verses from RV...' note on fol. 219.

A left-pointing ink arrow at about x 3054-3230, y 1820-1855. Its head is on the target side of the gutter (gutter at x≈3180) and its tail crosses into the facing margin. The fol. 219 image shows the same arrow at its left edge beside c. 308 (3). Whether it belongs to this page or the facing page is still uncertain.
